name: 雪山日落印花滑雪套装
description:
整套印满日落时分的雪山，粉橘色的山峰渐变到深蓝夜色，像把风景穿在身上。连帽上衣配直筒雪裤，在雪场上很显眼。尺码 S。

descriptionEn:
Covered head to toe in snowy peaks at sunset, fading from peachy pink summits into a deep blue night. It's like wearing the view. A hooded jacket with straight-leg pants that stand out on the slopes. Size S.

name: Juicy Candy 棋盘格滑雪套装

items.size: 上衣 L · 裤子 M

description:
酒红和蜜桃粉的复古棋盘格，上衣是棒球夹克版型，胸前绣着「Juicy Candy」字样，配同色宽松雪裤，日常也能穿。尺码：上衣 L，雪裤 M。

## 面料与科技
- 特氟龙三防工艺：防油、防污、防泼水
- 防水、透湿、防风
- 上衣内里夹棉，保暖防寒

## 设计细节
- 两侧插手拉链口袋
- 雪裤弹力腰头，腰部抽绳可调节
- 腰头 D 型环，可以挂雪卡
- 脚口内侧拉链，方便穿雪鞋

## 尺码（单位 cm）
- 上衣 L：后中长 72.5 · 胸围 127 · 袖长 55.4 · 摆围 102
- 雪裤 M：裤外长 100 · 腰围 76 · 臀围 117 · 闭合脚口 28
descriptionEn:
A retro burgundy and peach-pink checkerboard: a baseball-style bomber jacket with a 'Juicy Candy' patch on the chest, plus matching relaxed pants. Cute enough to wear off the mountain too. Sizes: jacket L, pants M.

## Fabric & Tech
- Teflon finish that repels oil, stains and water
- Waterproof, breathable and windproof
- Insulated jacket lining for warmth

## Design Details
- Zip hand pockets on both sides
- Stretch waistband with an adjustable drawcord
- D-ring on the waistband for a ski pass
- Inner zips at the leg openings to fit over snow boots

## Measurements (cm)
- Jacket L: back length 72.5 · chest 127 · sleeve 55.4 · hem 102
- Pants M: outseam 100 · waist 76 · hips 117 · cuff 28
